content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: `P1 - inference-queue.backlog.high`
service: inference-queue
scope: hosted/dedicated pools
symptoms: queue depth > 2500, avg enqueue latency 2.3s, token processing lag increasing
links: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345, dashboard: https://console.redwood/inference/queues

Maya K: acked via PD. I'm on it. grabbing metrics now.

Samir P: I'm nearby too, standing by to help scale or reroute traffic. Any affected customers yet?

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation policy: 5m -> second-oncall if unacknowledged. Acknowledged by Maya K.

Maya K: quick triage: autoscaler shows repeated scale attempts but pool reached max_replicas=18. We have 18/18 pods with GPUs at 99% util. Errors show "queue capacity exceeded" from gateway.

Liam O: confirmed. Cloud quota for worker-group-inference is at account limit (max vCPU/GPU). Looks like the autoscaler couldn't provision more instances due to AWS soft limit.

Doris R: checking recent deploys — nothing in last 2h. There's a traffic spike from a batch of customers, looks like one customer of note: acme-inc hitting a new heavy job pattern. Logs show many long-context requests.

Maya K: customer impact: degraded tail latency and ~5% 5xx for some routes; NFRs for enterprise customers might be impacted (acme-inc). I'll run emergency mitigations: 1) enable emergency_rate_limit on non-enterprise customers, 2) manual scale of pool to 24 if cloud quota allows, 3) redirect non-critical traffic to host fallback region.

Samir P: +1 on emergency rate limit. How to enable?

Maya K: run:
```
redwoodctl policy set-rate-limit --scope public --rps 50
```
That reduces load quickly.

Maya K: trying manual scale now: `redwoodctl scale pool inference-worker --replicas 24`

incident-bot: manual operation logged by Maya K: scale command executed.

Liam O: scaling command returned error: "insufficient capacity in region us-west-2; quota exceeded". Need to request quota bump or move to another region.

Doris R: I'm opening a support ticket for quota increase but that's not immediate. Propose moving low-priority traffic to eu-west-1 where we have spare capacity.

Samir P: I'll flip routing for public playground and background jobs to eu-west-1. How about canary 10% first?

Maya K: yes canary 10% then 100% for non-enterprise. Command:
```
redwoodctl route update --service inference-queue --from us-west-2 --to eu-west-1 --percent 10
```

Samir P: canary applied. Monitoring latency on canary now.

Liam O: note: cross-region adds ~60-80ms RTT, but should drop queue depth. Also will double egress cost; noted in incident.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note added: "manual scale attempted, cross-region canary started"

Maya K: early telemetry: queue depth dropping from 2700 -> 1600 in 6m after rate-limit + 10% canary. 5xx rate falling to 2.1%. Good sign.

Doris R: contacting account team to notify acme-inc about degraded performance and mitigation.

Samir P: customer message drafted: "We detected increased load affecting inference queues, applied emergency rate limits to public traffic and routed non-critical jobs to alternate region. Enterprise traffic preserved. We're monitoring and will update in 30m." Want review?

Maya K: looks good, send.

Liam O: recommending follow-up actions: request GPU quota bump for us-west-2, add autoscaler fallback to spill to other regions automatically, consider lower-cost small-model path for heavy jobs. Add to postmortem todos.

Maya K: will keep thread open. If queue depth remains <500 in 20m we can de-escalate. If we hit >2200 again, escalate to SRE lead.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: setting next escalation timer (20m)

Samir P: 10m update: queue at 900, 5xx at 1.4%. Can start lifting public rate limit to 80 rps to avoid user disruption.

Maya K: bumped public rate to 80 rps.

Doris R: acme-inc notified and support channel opened. They acknowledged, not currently opening PD.

Liam O: logging actions for postmortem: timestamps, scale attempt error, cross-region route, rate-limit commands.

Maya K: handing off to Samir for 30m watch while I take first break. Samir, please escalate if we see any regression.

Samir P: taking over watch. Thanks Maya. Setting reminder for 30m to collect metrics and start incident report.

incident-bot: Note: Incident acknowledged and mitigations applied. Current status: recovering.

Samir P: last update @1987654380 - queue depth 420, 5xx 0.6%, will keep monitoring. Planning incident report + follow-up tickets. :thumbsup:
